text: 美股三大股指集体高开，道指涨0.05%，标普500指数涨0.27%，纳指涨0.54%。光通信股开盘普涨，Lumentum涨超6%，康宁涨近3%；存储板块走高，美光、闪迪、SK海力士均涨超1%；SpaceX上涨3.3%，此前该公司达成协议，将收购全国性低频段频谱组合，T-Mobile US下跌9.6%，AT&T下跌8.2%；苹果下跌2.7%，报道称因需求疲软公司削减iPhone 18 Pro系列零部件产量。
text_en: The three major US stock indices opened collectively higher, with the Dow up 0.05%, the S&P 500 up 0.27% and the Nasdaq up 0.54%. Optical communication stocks rose broadly at the open, with Lumentum up more than 6% and Corning up nearly 3%; memory chip stocks advanced, with Micron, SanDisk and SK Hynix all up more than 1%; SpaceX rose 3.3% after reaching an agreement to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, while T-Mobile US fell 9.6% and AT&T fell 8.2%; Apple fell 2.7% after a report said the company cut component production for the iPhone 18 Pro series due to weak demand.
